-- Fix the query so it includes orders without receipts.
SELECT p.id, p.ordered, SUM(r.quantity) AS received
FROM purchase_order AS p JOIN receipt AS r ON p.id = r.order_id
GROUP BY p.id, p.ordered
ORDER BY p.id;

solution.sql
WITH receipt_total AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS received
    FROM receipt
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT p.id, p.ordered, COALESCE(r.received, 0) AS received
FROM purchase_order AS p LEFT JOIN receipt_total AS r ON p.id = r.order_id
ORDER BY p.id;
